name: PROTOCOL AI ARTILLERY: RELOCATE & COUNTER-BATTERY
scope: Both readable SQFs fully read. Binary startup/dependencies/licence unverified; no raw source copied.

contributions.intent: Identify actual artillery and obtain a reachable ammunition solution.
contributions.source: Land class shortlist then getArtilleryAmmo/ETA; chooses random ammunition after any reachable type is found.
contributions.cbe: CortexArtilleryAmmo/Fire/Aim and owner fire request use registered role, magazine/range solution and finite mission.
contributions.gap: Physical mixed-mod ammunition/range coverage remains pending; source random ammo is not a requirement.

contributions.intent: Move into range and displace after firing.
contributions.source: Random target-centred2500..3500m move with unbounded waitUntil; post-request sleep20..35s then random400..1000m move.
contributions.cbe: CortexArtilleryScoot uses current-owner token/session, original expiry, six candidate routes and operation generation. Mission firing acknowledgement remains distinct from request.
contributions.gap: Automatic pre-fire relocation into range is not demonstrated by shoot-and-scoot; do not claim that parity. Static mortars cannot be made mobile by crew doMove.

contributions.source: Scans every opposing artillery vehicle within7km and commands those enemy vehicles to fire at own artillery, without detection evidence.
contributions.cbe: CortexCounterBattery consumes firing events and qualified side radar or owner observer fixes; own registered counter-battery assets execute their own mission.
contributions.departure: Reject commanding the opposing faction or treating a global object query as detection.
contributions.gap: Physical radar/observer and owner-transfer validation pending.

contributions.source: Both branches declare private _rounds inside if/else; later doArtilleryFire reads outside those scopes. Random rounds are fractional.
contributions.cbe: Finite mission round/burst state rather than a branch-local undefined variable.
contributions.gap: Exact balance and ammunition consumption remain in-engine evidence.

costAndAuthority: No outer delay on idle global allGroups loop, repeated friendly nearTargets2500 peractor and global enemy group scans.
No pergun/crew locality, Zeus/native task or newer-operation cancellation after sleeps/waits.
Simple side inequality includes non-hostile/neutral cases; shared nearTargets candidates are not filtered as hostile before random selection.
configuration: Five CBA controls reviewed. Retain semantic CBE role/request/round/scoot controls; no duplicate source-branded task or settings module.
disposition: INTENT_COMPARISON_COMPLETE_FOR_READABLE_SCRIPTS; existing paths mapped, prefire range relocation remains a real gap. Not full implementation/parity.
